name: Reg race
summary: Class registration as a race: a running track with a lane per friend, each starting at their registration wave like a staggered start, and the open seats standing as a column of chairs by the finish; tap Got it and you sprint across the line and take a chair, miss it and you stop at the waitlist hurdle, or set a bell for five minutes before your wave.
